parameters.query:
insert into content_items (
  title,
  slug,
  category,
  confidence_label,
  target_duration_seconds,
  source_payload_json,
  status
)
values (
  '{{$json.title_sql}}',
  '{{$json.slug_sql}}',
  '{{$json.category_sql}}',
  '{{$json.confidence_label_sql}}',
  {{$json.target_duration_seconds_sql}},
  '{{$json.source_payload_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.status_sql}}'
)
returning content_id, title, slug, status, created_at;
